notes.title: Czech and Slovak Week!
notes.notes:
On the occasion of the special week of Czech and Slovak games I offer an update of this wacky satirical game! Primarily it is about fixing various bugs. [b]Also with the great Becherovka comes a great discount![/b]

[previewyoutube=XvoZjg-BNPc;full][/previewyoutube]

[list]
[*]The most annoying problem was the non-resetting of data, primarily the number of coins collected and the number of kills.
[*]Tangibly increased player variables: more lives, coins, bechers, number of steps, etc. If players can't reach the first boss after a few minutes of play, there's something wrong!
[*]Life regeneration increased. As well as more lives in medkits and less "hurt" in the early game.
[*]Red cards (or avalanche) that radically take away a player's lives are heavily restricted. But still, watch out for them!
[*]Occasional character hit when jumping out of a vehicle. Primarily didn't work with a specific age disease. Resolved.
[*]Music turns off properly when exiting Stand (Waves) mode.
[*]Screen shake is not as intense as it used to be in our time...
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35357520/8ff2ddb958a75b4562f1b3e4b5426bf040fe37e4.png[/img]

It's an update after a very long time for the simple reason that I've kind of refused to pay more attention to the game. It's really just one-off bulls*it. But even that deserves attention!

With Milos forever,
Thanks!

notes.title: Zeminator 1.19 update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] THE GAME IS a lot optimized and smoother, mainly because of new Clickteam Fusion update
[*] A lot bugs fixed: red cards permanent bug, double jumps, transitions to another environment etc.
[*] Frustration deleted, the game was unfortunately really unbalanced. Now you get a lot more money for 
killing npcs, new money and killing bonuses, faster gameplay, balanced weapons and ultimate weapons.
[*] 3 new shop items added
[/list]

1.2 version will be propably released soon aswell with new enviromnents, new AI possibilities and more.
